title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-06
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: A high‑quality Charlie Miller soundboard capture of the June 6 1970 Fillmore West show, highlighted by a scorching Alligator jam, a groovy Dancing Jam, rare New Orleans and an electric Lovelight > Not Fade Away > Lovelight sequence.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this recording’s clear, well‑balanced soundboard mix and the band’s fire‑breathing performance. The second set erupts after “Alligator” into a marathon jam that fuels a dazzling Dancing Jam, a rare New Orleans, and one of the most praised Lovelight/Not Fade Away transitions of the year. A few minor hiccups—such as a brief guitar drop‑out on the UJB encore—do little to dim the overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 15 detailed reviews, most giving 4–5 stars and praising both musical performance and sound quality; only a few low‑star outliers focus on minor technical issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller SBD transfer praised for clarity and balance; described as crisp though not quite as sharp as the famed 5/15 or 9/19 shows. Minor mix quirks noted (e.g., guitar drop‑out on UJB), but overall very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is solid but incomplete; the show truly ignites after “Alligator,” delivering an hour‑plus jam that fuels a spectacular second half with tight drumming, soaring guitar interplay, and memorable transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar shines on the Alligator jam and in the post‑drums interplay; occasional drop‑out on UJB noted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s rhythm work highlighted alongside Garcia, especially during the jam sections after Alligator.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming praised for tightness and dynamic “drum brakes” in the Darkness jam; a brief off‑beat moment on UJB mentioned.
